exposure: physical developmental indicators of infants (e.g., height)
cohort: The study included 88 preterm neonates with suspected NEC (29 confirmed NEC cases) and 30 preterm neonates in a control group, observed during 2020-2021.
finding: The birth of a newborn from the 3rd-4th pregnancy significantly increased the risk of NEC development (p=0.001), and infants with confirmed NEC had a significantly greater height (41.2+-0.7 cm) compared to those without NEC (38.9+-0.5 sm) (p=0.019).
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in terms of mode and type of delivery in the development of NEC.
